title.narrative: Supporting fiscal sustainability and improving access to finance

description.narrative: This project will produce a stochastic Debt Sustainability Analysis (DSA) toolkit enabling consistent dialogue with IFIs and increase member country access to financing. The DSA toolkit aims to complement the existing DSA framework by the IMF/WB. Commonwealth Meridian (the Commonwealth?s debt management tool) enables countries to produce medium term debt management reports, but there is no Commonwealth basis for evaluating the Commonwealth?s debt situation. The lack of a debt monitoring mechanism has limited the Commonwealth?s ability to advocate on its member?s behalf and has caused Commonwealth interventions (debt swaps) to appear ad-hoc. ?Monitoring will allow for consistent dialogue with IFIs and keep the Commonwealth informed of current and projected challenges, increasing the institution?s ability to advocate effectively. In a rapidly evolving environment, the development of complementary tools to understand debt dynamics and enhancement of debt sustainability is crucially important, especially following the sharp rise in debt stemming from the pandemic.
